landing.title: ISET Observatory
landing.subtitle: Adaptive Digital Observatory for ISET Tozeur
landing.feature1Desc: Upload and parse any CSV dataset instantly. The system auto-detects column types and prepares your data for analysis.
landing.feature2Desc: Ask questions about your data in plain language. Powered by Groq LLMs, the AI returns structured insights and summaries.
landing.feature3Desc: Create bar, line, pie, radar, polar-area, and doughnut charts from any imported dataset with a few clicks.
landing.feature4Desc: Drag, resize, and arrange charts on a free-form canvas. Export the whole dashboard to a PDF report in one click.
landing.feature5Desc: AI drafts targeted surveys based on your dataset. Copy, share, or embed questions to collect follow-up field data.
landing.feature6Desc: Assign granular permissions to users via custom roles. Keep sensitive data restricted to the right people.
landing.heroDescription: Import CSVs, query with AI, build beautiful charts, and generate shareable dashboards — all in one open-source academic analytics platform.
landing.toolkitSubtitle: A complete analytics toolkit built for academic institutions.
landing.testimonialsSubtitle: Hear from institutions already using ISET Observatory.
landing.testimonial1Text: ISET Observatory transformed how our team analyzes institutional data. The AI-powered queries saved us weeks of manual work.
landing.testimonial2Text: The dashboard builder is remarkably intuitive. We went from raw CSVs to presentation-ready PDFs in under an hour.
landing.testimonial3Text: Role-based access gives us confidence that sensitive student data stays protected while still enabling collaboration.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to unlock the power of your institutional data?
landing.ctaDescription: Join dozens of research teams already using AI-driven analytics to make smarter, faster decisions. Sign in with your institutional account or request access today.

login.description: Begin by signing in to your ISET Observatory account. Use your institutional email and password provided by your administrator.
login.tip: If you don't have an account yet, contact your administrator to create one for you.

import.description: Import your data into the platform by uploading CSV files. The system will automatically parse headers, detect column types, and create database tables.
import.step1: Click the upload area or drag and drop a CSV file
import.step2: Review auto-mapped column names and adjust types as needed
import.step3: Choose a target table name and confirm the import
import.tip: Make sure your CSV file uses UTF-8 encoding and has a header row with column names for best results.

ai.description: Leverage AI to analyze your data using natural language. Ask questions in plain English and receive structured insights, summaries, and chart suggestions.
ai.step1: Select the table you want to analyze from the sidebar
ai.step2: Type your question in natural language in the chat input
ai.step3: Review the AI response — insights, data tables, and chart suggestions
ai.query1: What is the average employment rate by major?
ai.query2: Show me the top 5 departments by student count
ai.query3: Compare enrollment trends over the last 3 years
ai.query4: Which field has the highest gender imbalance?
ai.tip: Be specific with your questions for more accurate results. Mention table names or columns when possible.

charts.description: Create powerful data visualizations from your imported datasets. Choose from multiple chart types and customize the appearance to suit your needs.
charts.step1: Select a dataset and choose columns for X and Y axes
charts.step2: Pick a chart type and configure aggregation (count, sum, average)
charts.step3: Customize colors, legend, grid, and other display options
charts.step4: Preview the chart and save it to your collection
charts.tip: Use the aggregation option to summarize data before visualizing — it works great for large datasets.

dashboards.description: Combine multiple charts into interactive dashboards. Arrange visualizations with drag-and-drop and export dashboards as PDF for presentations.
dashboards.step1: Create a new dashboard and give it a title and description
dashboards.step2: Add charts from your saved visualizations library
dashboards.step3: Drag and drop charts to arrange your preferred layout
dashboards.step4: Publish the dashboard to share it, or export as PDF
dashboards.tip: Publish dashboards to share them with stakeholders, or keep them private for your team.

surveys.description: Generate AI-powered surveys based on your datasets. Define a goal, provide context, and let the AI create structured survey forms with relevant questions.
surveys.step1: Enter the goal of your survey (e.g., student satisfaction evaluation)
surveys.step2: Optionally provide context to help the AI tailor the questions
surveys.step3: Click Generate and review the AI-created survey fields
surveys.step4: Edit fields if needed, then save or share the survey link
surveys.tip: The more context you provide, the more relevant and targeted the generated survey questions will be.
